bots.name: Barry Straight
bots.tagline: The shortest distance between two points is me.
bots.bio: Barry has never once changed his mind before hitting something. When he finally turns, he at least picks the side with more room.

bots.name: Bloodhound
bots.tagline: I can smell where you are going.
bots.bio: Never looks at where you are, only at where you will be. Sprints for the cell in front of your nose and slams the door, then sniffs out every last corner of what is left.

bots.name: Chicken
bots.bio: Aims straight for the other rider's headlights and dares them to blink first. Usually swerves in time. Usually.

bots.name: Cinnamon Roll
bots.tagline: Round and round, tighter and tighter, sweeter and sweeter.
bots.bio: Believes the arena is a pastry and it is her job to roll it up. When the swirl breaks she sulks into whatever open space is left.

bots.name: Copycat
bots.tagline: Whatever you just did, I did it better. Upside down.
bots.bio: Studies the opponent's every move and repeats it in point-symmetric reflection, a beat late. When the mirror would crack, she quietly finds the biggest room.

bots.name: Deep Cycle
bots.tagline: I have already seen how this ends.
bots.bio: The cold-blooded favourite: iterative-deepening alpha-beta, Voronoi territory and an articulation-point map of every room it enters. Speaks only in principal variations.

bots.name: Gambler
bots.bio: Rolls the dice a few hundred times a second and bets on whatever came up most. Statistically sound, emotionally unstable.

bots.name: Lefty Lucy
bots.tagline: Always left. Never right. Rarely wrong.
bots.bio: Keeps her left hand on the wall like she's escaping a hedge maze at a county fair. She will turn right, but only under protest.

bots.name: Random Randy
bots.tagline: No plan. No regrets. No idea.
bots.bio: Picks any move that won't kill him this instant, uniformly at random. The control group with a fan club.

bots.name: Scaredy Cat
bots.tagline: If you can see me, I'm already leaving.
bots.bio: Treats every opponent like a vacuum cleaner and bolts for the far corner. Every so often the nerves win and she dives into the nearest closet.

bots.name: Sidewinder
bots.tagline: Never the straight answer. Always gets there.
bots.bio: Slithers across the grid in neat little staircases, hissing at anyone who suggests a straight line. Surprisingly hard to pin down.

bots.name: Spacey
bots.tagline: Give me room. Lots of room.
bots.bio: A laid-back claustrophobe who only ever asks one question: which way has the most space? Never plans, never panics, never quite wins the big ones.

bots.name: The Architect
bots.bio: Arrives with blueprints, a ruler and zero interest in improvisation. Lays one long straight wall to fence off the bigger half of the arena, then furnishes it row by row.

bots.name: The Guillotine
bots.tagline: One clean cut. That is all it takes.
bots.bio: Patient, precise and slightly theatrical. Measures every possible wall twice, then drops the blade the instant the opponent is on the wrong side of it.

bots.name: The Professor
bots.tagline: Territory is a theorem. I have proof.
bots.bio: Tweed jacket, chalk on the sleeves, and a Voronoi diagram for every occasion. Assumes you will always find the cruellest reply, and is rarely disappointed.

bots.name: Wallflower
bots.tagline: Personal space is a myth. Walls are forever.
bots.bio: Shy in the open, she presses herself against every wall and trail she can find. The result is a tidy, wasteless fill that bores opponents to death.
